review_notes: DRAFT generated by a model. Not trusted until a human reviews it.
Check every description against the reference image, especially mark geometry and branding text.
critical flags were proposed by a fixed rule (mark/shape/color_material: true, detail: false, branding: true). Adjust each one.
When approved: save as profiles/<name>.json with human_verified=true, verified_by and verified_at.

attributes.description: Low-top basketball-style silhouette with a rounded toe box and thick rubber outsole.
Primary upper is light blue patent leather; accents in bright yellow; laces and outsole are a medium blue.
Four-pointed elongated yellow star logo on the side panel.
Zig-zag stitching detail on the tongue tab above the branding.
Reinforced eyelet panel with light blue round laces.
Insole features a black and white graphic resembling a stylized wing or comet tail.

branding.location: Printed on the heel area of the insole
